chapters.title: Puddlespike Trial 1
chapters.blurb: The air here is never still. Gusts rise without warning and carry everything that flies; the clever play the wind rather than fight it. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 2, proposer mutation).
chapters.text:
Puddlespike Trial 1: puddle 5 [0..32], spike 0 [0..5], net 2 [0..6]
  [0] anchor: their puddle += ((their action == 1) ? -4 : 0); my puddle += ((their action == 1) ? 2 : 0)
  [1] ward: my puddle += ((their action == 1) ? 3 : 0); my puddle += 1; my puddle += 1
  [2] sever: my puddle += ((their action == 0) ? 6 : 0); my puddle += 1
  each round: my puddle += 1
  ends: (my puddle >= 26) => I win; after 27 rounds higher 'puddle' wins

chapters.title: Puddlespike Trial 2
chapters.blurb: The air here is never still. Gusts rise without warning and carry everything that flies; the clever play the wind rather than fight it. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 5, proposer mutation).
chapters.text:
Puddlespike Trial 2: net 0 [0..19], spike 3 [0..6], soak 2 [0..6]
  [0] fracture: my net += ((their action == 2) ? 2 : 0); my net += 1; their net += ((their action == 1) ? -7 : -1)
  [1] bloom: their net += ((their action == 1) ? -4 : 0); my net += ((their action == 1) ? 2 : 0); their net += ((their action == 2) ? -4 : -1)
  [2] siphon: their net += ((their action == 3) ? -2 : 0); my net += ((their action == 3) ? 1 : 0); their net += ((their action == 3) ? -3 : 0); my net += ((their action == 3) ? 1 : 0)
  [3] glide: their net += ((their action == 0) ? -2 : 0); my net += ((their action == 0) ? 1 : 0)
  each round: my net += 1
  ends: (my net >= 13) => I win; after 14 rounds higher 'net' wins

chapters.title: Puddlespike Trial 3
chapters.blurb: The air here is never still. Gusts rise without warning and carry everything that flies; the clever play the wind rather than fight it. Rule set discovered by the foundry (cycle search, generation 6, proposer grammar).
chapters.text:
Puddlespike Trial 3: spike 5 [0..31], balloon 2 [0..6]
  [0] pulse: their spike += ((their action == 3) ? -8 : -1); their spike += ((their action == 3) ? -4 : -1)
  [1] tether: my spike += 3; my balloon += 2
  [2] kindle: their spike += ((their action == 3) ? -3 : 0); my spike += ((their action == 3) ? 1 : 0)
  [3] glide: my spike += ((their action == 1) ? 4 : 0); my spike += 1; their spike += ((their action == 1) ? -3 : 0); my spike += ((their action == 1) ? 1 : 0)
  each round: my spike += 1
  ends: (my spike >= 25) => I win; after 29 rounds higher 'spike' wins

tagline: Three trials of the Puddlespike. Learn each law, then outplay the adaptive rival.
